component.name: Antigravity
component.summary: Run and supervise AI coding agents

description.p: Antigravity is Google's desktop app for agentic development. Agents plan and carry out tasks in your projects, edit files, run commands and use a browser, and the app shows their progress and the changes they make. Projects on remote machines can be opened over SSH.
This community-maintained Flatpak downloads the official Linux build from Google during installation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
Initial Flatpak packaging of the official Linux build.
